description: Source code for slot management and library loading in a firmware update system, including version comparison, installation management, and dynamic library loading with fallback and rollback mechanisms.

methods.name: CompareEvergreenVersion
methods.description: Compares two version strings segmented by '.'; returns 1 if first is newer, -1 if older, 0 if equal or invalid.

methods.name: ReadEvergreenVersion
methods.description: Reads the 'version' field from a manifest JSON file at a given path.

methods.name: GetEvergreenVersionByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the version string from the manifest of a specific installation index.

methods.name: RevertBack
methods.description: Reverts to a previous installation, optionally marking the current as bad.

methods.name: CheckBadFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a bad app key file exists for a given installation path and app key.

methods.name: AdoptInstallation
methods.description: Adopts an installation if a good app key file exists, resetting and rolling forward if needed.

methods.name: LoadSlotManagedLibrary
methods.description: Main function to initialize installation, handle versioning, retries, rollback, and load the library dynamically.
